title: Four Fashionable Women Outside House, 1964 B&W Snapshot
description: A vintage black and white snapshot dated April 1964 showing four women dressed in mid-century attire standing on a concrete path outside a suburban home. The women wear tailored skirts, jackets, pillbox-style hats, and carry handbags, showcasing typical early 1960s American women's fashion. In the background, a period automobile is parked near a neighbouring structure.
